# Card r1-a-1: Rolling Slam aftershock clear

## Brainstorm half

### Identity

- Class: Warrior
- Ascendancy: Titan
- Named damage source: Rolling Slam

### Pitch

- Name: Rolling Slam aftershock clear
- Why pick it: The aftershock hits every pack twice, so one slam clears a screen.
- How it clears: Slam into the pack and walk on; the aftershock finishes it.
- Bosses: Slam the boss twice a cycle; no boss button.
- Needs: a two-handed mace and Fist of War; online at level 4; no respec; cheap
- The catch: The aftershock lags, so a fast pack can walk out of it.
- Playstyle: melee, one-button, clear

### Chain

- Damage source: Rolling Slam, carried by the weapon in Weapon 1.
- Multipliers: its supports.
- Enablers: none.
- Consumes or requires: nothing.
